body:
Track 2 follow-up to `ambient-interject`: online interruption policies (greedy, epsilon-greedy, Thompson) learning only from accept/dismiss feedback, compared with an offline oracle. Simulated, stylised, mostly negative results (uninformed prior never learns; bandit fails under drift). 6 tests, `python site/build.py` prints ok, README bullet and site entry added. Citations (Horvitz 1999, Li et al. 2010, Chapelle & Li 2011) checked by web search.
